bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USTB is issued natively on Ethereum, Plume, and Solana. Separately, Superstate documents an issuer-native EVM burn/mint path: Plume holders burn source USTB and receive the specified amount on a supported destination, with Plume supportedChainIds(1) = true for Ethereum. The same issuer EOA controls destination mint authorization and the Plume token/proxy-admin upgrade path; no external validator, DVN, rate-limit committee, or timelock was evidenced. SVM bridging is explicitly unsupported and no Solana bridge route is authored.

routes.reviewNote: Ethereum is a documented native USTB issuance network. The token proxy owner and ProxyAdmin owner are the issuer EOA; the separate Plume-to-Ethereum burn/mint capability is reviewed as a bridge route and does not change this native classification.

Superstate lists Plume as an issuance network. At Plume block 87678057, the verified proxy exposes owner-only mint and bulkMint, owner 0xad309BB6f13074128b4F23EF9EA2fe8552AfCA83, and ProxyAdmin 0xa5df717b304a50838c72cd310c8df636b1aecfa3 owned by the same issuer EOA. This direct local liability source remains native even though the same implementation also exposes an issuer-native bridge().

Superstate documents Solana as an issuance network and explicitly states that SVM bridging is not supported. At finalized slot 439721950, Token-2022 mintAuthority is EfkJFKtVcpo8sgQGWLoaYcutxNdmqed81wdCcpn7egdz with supply 224,119.498751 USTB.

routes.protocol: Superstate issuer-native EVM bridge (Plume to Ethereum)
routes.reviewNote: Superstate smart-contract documentation describes EVM bridge() as burning source-chain USTB and delivering the specified amount on a supported destination. The verified Plume implementation returned supportedChainIds(1) = true at block 87678057, establishing the Plume-to-Ethereum route. The Plume token remains a native issuance deployment; this row separately represents its issuer-native cross-chain burn/mint capability.

The issuer EOA 0xad309BB6f13074128b4F23EF9EA2fe8552AfCA83 owns the Plume token and ProxyAdmin 0xa5df717b304a50838c72cd310c8df636b1aecfa3 and can authorize destination minting.
